subject.title: [Bug]: openai-responses sends role="system" instead of role="developer" for reasoning models

question: For custom `openai-responses` providers, should OpenClaw support strict relays that reject system-prompt messages via existing developer-role semantics, a new top-level-instructions placement compat key, or no additional core behavior?
rationale: The report is valid for a real relay class, but the codebase also has the opposite compatibility class where non-native providers reject `developer`, and adding prompt-placement config creates a public provider contract.

options.title: Sponsor default-preserving compat
options.body: Keep current defaults, then update or replace the candidate PR so current `@openclaw/ai` supports a documented opt-in strict-relay request shape with regression coverage.

options.title: Flip reasoning Responses proxies
options.body: Make reasoning custom Responses models send `developer` by default, accepting that providers which reject `developer` may regress.

options.title: Decline core support
options.body: Treat this relay class as unsupported in core and point affected users to `openai-completions` or an external relay/plugin-specific workaround.

recommendation.title: Sponsor default-preserving compat
recommendation.body: Keep current defaults, then update or replace the candidate PR so current `@openclaw/ai` supports a documented opt-in strict-relay request shape with regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the clearest merged history on the Responses developer-role compatibility invariant that this decision would extend or revise.
